title: 2011 HMMT February Algebra and Combinatorics Problem 9
statement:
For all real numbers \(x\), let

\[f(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt[2011]{1-x^{2011}}}\]

Evaluate \((f(f(\ldots(f(2011)) \ldots)))^{2011}\), where \(f\) is applied 2010 times.

solutions.text: \(2011^{2011}\) Direct calculation shows that \(f(f(x))=\frac{\sqrt[2011]{1-x^{2011}}}{-x}\) and \(f(f(f(x)))=x\). Hence \((f(f(\ldots(f(x)) \ldots)))=x\), where \(f\) is applied 2010 times. So \((f(f(\ldots(f(2011)) \ldots)))^{2011}=\) \(2011^{2011}\).
